title: Excessive Error Disclosure - Stack Trace Exposure in 500 Errors
description: The vulnerable error handler middleware (vulnerableErrorHandler.ts) exposes full stack traces in HTTP 500 error responses. When an unhandled exception occurs, the error handler returns the complete stack trace in the JSON response body under the 'error.stack' field. This exposes internal code structure, file paths, line numbers, and function call chains to potential attackers, aiding reconnaissance and exploitation of other vulnerabilities.
impact: Information disclosure facilitating reconnaissance and targeted attacks. Attackers can trigger 500 errors (e.g., via SQL injection payloads) to obtain stack traces revealing internal code structure, file paths, library versions, and call stacks. This intelligence aids in crafting more sophisticated attacks against other vulnerabilities.
mitigation: 1) Implement secure error handler that only returns generic error messages in production (code, message). 2) Log full stack traces server-side for debugging, but return sanitized responses to clients. 3) Implement environment-based error handling: development mode shows details, production mode returns generic messages. 4) Use secure error handler from api-secure which only returns { code, message } without stack traces or internal details.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for stack trace exposure in 500 errors
